description: Large framed watercolor of the inside of Pullen Park Carousel by Pam Shank in 1982. It features Standing Horse #2 in the middle, Ostrich's #11A and #11B on the right, and Pig #16A on the left. In the middle background, you can kind of see the Whurlitzer. "P. Shank" signature in the bottom right corner. Cream colored mat with black frame and hanging wire on the back.

The photograph is of the Pullen Park Carousel. The center of the photograph  is a brown horse with a green, red, white, gold, and black colored saddle. There are other horses in the back ground. There is a tiger, giraffe, and pig toward the left of the center horse. Trees and a building can be seen outside of the windows behind the carousel. The photo is glossy and in color. The back has yellow text that states "Kodak Official Sponsor of the Olympic Games" with the Olympic logo and "Kodak Royal Paper." There is black text that reads <No. 4A> 515 21+00 NNNNN+14AU0143.

The photograph is of Pullen Park Carousel and is glossy and in color. The photo has a tan/yellow horse in the center. The horse has a green, red, yellow, and black saddle. there is a mouth of a lion and a pig that can be seen on the left and the back half of a cat on the right of the horse. There are other animals in the background. Through the windows around the carousel green trees can be seen. The back of the phot is white and has gold colored text reads "Kodak Official Sponsor of the Olympic Games" with the Olympic logo below and "Kodak Royal Paper." There is black text that reads <No.6A>515 21+1 NNNNN+17AU 0143.

Glossy color photograph of Pullen Park Carousel. Photo has a dappled gray carousel horse in the center with a white and red bridle, a brown, black and gold saddle, and green, red, orange, and gold tack. Behind it are a brown and white horse with a brown, blue, orange, and red saddle, and a pig with a red and green saddle. In the background is a blurry view of trees in Pullen Park. Reverse is white with gold text reading " Kodak-Official Sponsor of the Olympic Games" and "Kodak Royal Paper." Printed black text reads "<No.9A>515 21+00 NNNNN+25AU 0143."

Glossy color photograph of Pullen Park Carousel. Photo has a pig with tan, pink, red, and green saddle at the center. Behind it is another pig and three horses. In the background is the mirrored carousel center and a blurred view of Pullen Park. Reverse is white with gold text reading "Kodak-Official Sponsor of the Olympic Games" with the Olympic rings and "Kodak Royal Paper." Black printed text reads "<No.12A>515 21+1 NNNNN+20AU 0141."

A color photograph taken inside the Pullen Park Carousel house of 4 horses, 1 chariot, 1 pig, 2 rabbits, and 2 ostriches. From left to right: a yellow ear; the back half of a pig with green and pink red trim decorative harnesses and part of the brown seat; a brown horse with a black mane, white snout, and the white lower legs that has a brown seat and yellow trimmed green harness; a chariot with burgundy seats and brown and green decorative sides; a brown horse with a black mane that has a red and yellow trimmed green harness and a brown seat; a brown horse from the chest up with a black trimmed green harness and a brown seat; a white and light brown/gray horse with a black/brown mane and a red trimmed pink harness; a gray rabbit with a red trimmed pink harness; the ear of a brown rabbit; two blue and gray ostriches. The carousel house is screened in and a white man in a white shirt is visible.

Reverse is white with gold text reading "Kodak-Official Sponsor of the Olympic Games" with the Olympic rings and "Kodak Royal Paper." Black printed text reads "<No.15A>515 21+1 NNNNN+15AU 0141."

A color photograph taken inside the Pullen Park Carousel house of 2 horses and 2 cats. From left to right: the head and part of the chest of a brown horse; the front half of a yellow horse with a white/yellow mane; a brown and white cat with a fish in its mouth that has a blue-green harness, a green saddle blanket, and a brown saddle; a gray cat with a green saddle blanket. In the background, two ostriches and a pig are visible.

Reverse is white with gold text reading "Kodak-Official Sponsor of the Olympic Games" with the Olympic rings and "Kodak Royal Paper." Black printed text reads "<No.3A>515 21+00 NNNNN+19AU 0143."

A color photograph taken inside the Pullen Park Carousel house of 3 horses and 1 pig with other animals visible, but too dark to describe. From left to right: a cream pig with a red-trimmed green harness; a brown horse; a cream horse with a white mane and tail that has a red-trimmed pink harness, a green saddle blanket, and a light brown saddle; a brown horse with a black mane and tail that has a red-trimmed blue harness and saddle blanket.

Reverse is white with gold text reading "Kodak-Official Sponsor of the Olympic Games" with the Olympic rings and "Kodak Royal Paper." Black printed text reads "<No.10A>515 21+1 NNNNN+29AU 0141."

A color photograph taken inside the Pullen Park Carousel house of a lion, 2 horses, a pig, a chariot, and a giraffe. From left to right: the head of a giraffe; part of the red seated chariot; a cream horse with a black mane, knees and muzzle that has a gold trimmed red harness; a brown horse with a cream muzzle; the head of a pig; and a yellow lion with a brown mane that has a gold wing harness. The ground is dirt, sand, and mulch.

Reverse is white with gold text reading "Kodak-Official Sponsor of the Olympic Games" with the Olympic rings and "Kodak Royal Paper." Black printed text reads "<No.11A>515 21-2 NNNNN+28AU 0141."
